protocol.coverage: threshold-constrained maximum-cardinality bipartite matching; GT and predictions used at most once
protocol.candidate_pool: native class-selected 100 detections, ordered by native fused score; not all 300 decoder queries
protocol.fixed_score05: maximum TP/minimum FP,FN assignment at score>=0.5, distinct from official score-greedy COCO matching
protocol.normalization: coverage denominator includes all 1533 supplied GT; negative images retained for AP and false alarms
